name: dexmond-atlas
description: Authorized infrastructure intelligence for Claude: map the systems you authorize, run bounded discovery, and surface automation opportunities. Read-only tools plus authorized discovery; any change needs human approval inside ATLAS. Runs locally with no hosting required.

authorized_networks.title: Authorized scan scope (optional)
authorized_networks.description: Comma-separated CIDRs the local ATLAS is authorized to discover, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Empty means no scope: nothing is scanned until you authorize a network. Unrestricted ranges (0.0.0.0/0, ::/0) are refused. Only authorize networks you own or are permitted to assess.

remote_base_url.title: Remote ATLAS URL (optional)
remote_base_url.description: Leave empty for local-first: a local ATLAS boots automatically on 127.0.0.1 with no scan scope until you authorize one. Set this to the URL of a self-hosted ATLAS to connect to that instead.

remote_token.title: Remote ATLAS token (optional)
remote_token.description: Operator bearer token for a self-hosted ATLAS. Only used when a remote URL is set.

remote_customer.title: Remote ATLAS workspace (optional)
remote_customer.description: Workspace / customer id (X-Atlas-Customer) for a self-hosted ATLAS. Only used when a remote URL is set.
